title: Will Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez endorse Darializa Avila Chevalier in NY-13 before Nov 3, 2026?
rules: If Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez publicly endorses Darializa Avila Chevalier in NY-13 before Nov 3, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: An endorsement requires a clear, affirmative statement of support for the nominee's election. The statement must be public (not private communications) and specifically reference the race or be clearly in context of the race. The endorsement must come directly from the person or through their official channels. Positive comments without explicit support, policy endorsements without nominee endorsement, or conditional endorsements do not qualify. Social media endorsements count only from verified accounts, and likes or retweets alone do not constitute endorsement. Quote tweets with additional supportive commentary do count. Sarcastic statements or those immediately clarified as jokes do not qualify.

blind.reasoning: AOC deliberately stayed out of the NY-13 primary, and CNN noted in late August that she had not endorsed Avila Chevalier. Since then she has only praised her in general terms and defended her, which the market rules exclude. With about two weeks left in a safe-Democratic general election and controversy over Avila Chevalier's Oct. 8 rally attendance, AOC has little reason to make an explicit endorsement, though a last-minute slate post or rally appearance is possible.
blind.falsifier: AOC posts on her verified account, or says at a rally, that voters should elect Darializa Avila Chevalier to Congress in NY-13 before Nov 3, 2026.

final.reasoning: The market midpoint of 0.12 sits almost exactly on my independent estimate of 0.13, so there is no meaningful edge after the spread. I'm keeping my number and passing rather than paying 0.14 for YES or selling at 0.10.
